analogy.rationale: BAX-mediated cytochrome C release is the point of mitochondrial apoptosis commitment; BCL inhibitors act on the same BCL-2 family axis and caspase activators act immediately downstream, while most other classes engage unrelated pathways. Because the assay measures transcriptional change and these cells are not necessarily apoptosis-primed, the response is expected to be weak.
